free_tier.stated: 250 GB increments, up to 25 TB, 5 TB max object size

per_object_cap.stated: 5 TB per object, with no object size minimum

egress.terms: Truly free and unlimited — page title is 'S3-Compatible & Free Egress'; body: 'unlimited transfer included in the flat monthly rate', 'no hidden traffic or download' charges, 'retrieval is not billed separately'. Requests also included.

limits.value: 5 TB per object, with no object size minimum

limits_note: Slice granularity of 250 GB means you cannot right-size. 5 TB max object size. Regions: EU, US Central, Singapore (+€0.50). No egress fees, no request fees, no retrieval fees — the pricing model is genuinely simple.

identity_cost.detail: the order form's Personal Data fields are listed as a first and last name, an email address, a phone number and a postal address, and the vendor words them as fields these may include, so a phone number is asked and whether it is required is not stated. Payment is by credit card, PayPal, Skrill, bank transfer or direct debit, and every rail other than credit card needs the first payment done manually

reliability_note: Triple-replicated Ceph per their docs. The structural oddity: this is the ONLY mainstream S3 provider here with free egress AND no retrieval fee AND no minimum storage duration — but the per-TB price is 2.5× Datalix and 5× Hetzner.
